# Pendexter

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P24](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0024), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P42](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0042)</sub>

## Appearance

Pendexter is a tall and stately figure who is wonderfully gowned. She features a beautiful, highbred face complemented by large, violet eyes with black lashes.

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022)_

## History

Pendexter lives in New York with her husband, who is a millionaire. She unexpectedly visited [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) alongside [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) and the famous author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md). During the visit, she enjoyed a dinner and a walk hosted by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) before departing.

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P24](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0024), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P33](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0033), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P42](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0042), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P43](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0043)_

## Relationships

### [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/morgan--pendexter.md)

Mrs. Pendexter is a friend of Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md), traveling alongside the famous author during their visits. She joins Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) on an unexpected stop at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where they are hosted by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) for dinner and a walk around the property before taking their leave.

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P24](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0024), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P33](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0033), +2 more_
